predictions.quote: Like I think Democrats are slight favorites to win in 2028.

predictions.quote: Prediction markets say Democrats are around I think 80 or 85% to take the House and 40 or 45% to take the Senate. Those both seem pretty reasonable to me. I think if anything it's a little bit low on the House. Um I think it might be more like 85 or 90.
predictions.prediction: Democrats will take the House in the 2026 midterms, with roughly an 85-90% probability.

predictions.quote: Probably probably slight edge to the GOP with maybe gas prices and Iran determining whether it's more truly 50/50 or maybe maybe 60% GOP.
predictions.prediction: The GOP will hold the Senate in the 2026 midterms, with roughly a 50-60% probability depending on gas prices and the Iran conflict.
AOC (not Gavin Newsom) will be the Democratic insurgent, anti-establishment 'burn it down' candidate to watch heading into 2028, as Newsom's standing fades.
